integrations.title: Course integrations
integrations.empty: Integration service is unavailable. Check that the integrations container is running.
integrations.credentialsMeta: Enter account access for this platform. Private courses stay unavailable without it.
integrations.secretStored: Secret already stored. Enter a new value to replace it.

stepik.help: Get the Client ID and secret at stepik.org/oauth2/applications after creating an app.

integrations.publicMeta: No credentials required. The catalog is available immediately.

tutor.messagePlaceholder: e.g. why do I need a JOIN here?

theory.0: Read the section again and underline key terms.
theory.1: Try explaining the idea in one sentence without looking at the text.

video.0: Watch the clip once for the main idea, then replay for details.
video.1: Pause after each section and note one takeaway.

code.0: Start from the expected result and which tables or inputs you need.
code.1: Solve the simplest case first, then refine the conditions.

quiz.0: Eliminate answers that contradict the study material.
quiz.1: Recall definitions before guessing between similar options.

lab.0: Match the instructions with the expected outcome of the step.
lab.1: If stuck, revisit the previous theory lesson in the outline.
